ayahs.1: When the hypocrites—those with nifaq, outward acceptance with inward rejection—come to you, they say: 'We bear witness that you are the Messenger of Allah.' Allah knows you are His Messenger, but Allah bears witness that the hypocrites are liars.
ayahs.2: They use their oaths as a shield, blocking the path of Allah. How evil is what they do.
ayahs.3: This is because they believed and then abandoned faith, so their hearts were sealed and they do not comprehend.
ayahs.4: When you see them, their appearance impresses you; when they speak, you listen to their polished words. But they are like worthless planks leaned against a wall. They think every cry is against them. They are the enemy—beware of them. May Allah condemn them! How can they be deluded from the truth?
ayahs.5: When it is said to them: 'Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you,' they turn their heads in disgust, and you see them turn away in arrogance.
ayahs.6: It makes no difference whether you pray for their forgiveness or not—Allah will not forgive them. He does not guide a rebellious people.
ayahs.7: They say to one another: 'Do not spend on those with the Messenger of Allah so they will break away from him.' Yet to Allah alone belong the treasuries of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not comprehend.
ayahs.8: They say: 'If we return to Medina, the honourable will expel the inferior.' But all honour and power belong to Allah, His Messenger, and the believers—yet the hypocrites do not know.
ayahs.9: O believers: do not let your wealth or your children divert you from the remembrance of Allah. Whoever does so are the true losers.
ayahs.10: Give from what We have provided before death comes to one of you and he cries: 'My Lord, if only You delayed me a little, I would give in charity and be among the righteous.'
ayahs.11: Allah never delays a soul when its appointed time comes. He is All-Aware of what you do.
